title: English Practice Quiz 0994
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A machine stops working during a shift. What is the best first response?
options: Report the fault and follow the safety procedure
Ask an untrained person to repair it
questions.explanation: Report the fault and follow approved safety steps rather than risking injury.

questions.question: To 'clarify' a point means to ___.
questions.explanation: Clarify means explain something so it becomes clear.

questions.question: One of the applicants ___ already been interviewed.
questions.explanation: The subject one is singular and takes has.

questions.question: Which apology sounds professional?
options: I apologise for the delay. Thank you for your patience.
questions.explanation: A professional apology names the issue and acknowledges the other person's patience.

questions.question: An 'obstacle' is something that ___.
questions.explanation: An obstacle is a barrier or difficulty that prevents progress.

questions.question: I would rather you ___ the details with the supervisor.
questions.explanation: Would rather + subject is commonly followed by the past simple for a preference.

questions.question: Which phrase is appropriate when you attach a file to an email?
options: I have attached the requested file.
I am putting a file somewhere.
questions.explanation: This is a standard, clear phrase for an email attachment.

questions.question: The medicine should be stored in a cool, dry ___.
questions.explanation: Place is the noun needed after the adjective pair cool, dry.

questions.question: No sooner had he entered ___ the phone rang.
questions.explanation: The fixed construction is no sooner...than.

questions.question: If you do not understand an instruction, you should ___.
options: ask the speaker to explain it again
questions.explanation: Asking for clarification prevents mistakes and improves safety.
